title: CRASH DETAILS
source: Shared passive Rust adapter_diagnostics.rs, identical in Android and desktop
fields: last observed adapter state and phase
identification: Retain model/firmware from GET_INFO before compatibility rejection. Observation never enables an unsupported adapter.
unknown: Unavailable or unknown is explicit. Selected family is not a verified model. A transport-close acknowledgement is not an ECU result.
retention: The same local snapshot is in Console, crash-diagnostics.json, crash.json and report.json. Android refreshes after host cleanup, including its prebuilt MDI engine; first failure is preserved.
privacy: Known model and bounded version tokens only. No serial, VIN, raw identity, bus traffic, security payload or credential in this summary.
upload: The existing deployed review/consent schema is preserved. Support uploads include the existing validated firmware_version field plus existing state/failure/cleanup evidence; the full local crash snapshot remains in saved logs.
